features.title: Create Python project skeleton and recovery init
features.description: Create the project-owned Python package, tests directory, environment template, dependency manifest, README scaffold, tmp placeholder, and update root ./init.sh so a fresh checkout can verify the harness plus basic project recovery without requiring microphone or OpenAI credentials.
acceptance: Project-owned paths exist for src/, tests/, README.md, .env.example, requirements.txt, and tmp/.gitkeep.
Root ./init.sh still runs .agent-harness/scripts/init.sh and also verifies the Python project can be imported or compiled.
The project recovery check is idempotent, emits clear setup and verification logs, and exits non-zero on failure.
A fake or dry-run smoke command exists so recovery can verify a core application path without microphone, speaker, or OpenAI access.
Documentation states that Python 3.11 or 3.12 is the supported MVP runtime.

features.title: Implement configuration loading and runtime diagnostics
features.description: Load .env-backed settings for OpenAI, audio, wake-word, recording, and model defaults, and provide diagnostics that clearly report missing credentials, unsupported Python versions, missing afplay, and microphone-permission guidance.
acceptance: src/config.py loads documented environment variables with typed defaults and validation errors.
.env.example includes OpenAI, wake threshold, silence, max recording, sample rate, and model configuration.
A diagnostic command or function reports whether Python version, afplay, dependency imports, and required environment variables are available.
Missing OPENAI_API_KEY is reported as an actionable configuration error without crashing import-time code.
Unit tests cover defaults, environment overrides, and invalid configuration values.

features.title: Implement audio stream, silence detection, and WAV recording
features.description: Add reusable audio input, RMS silence detection, and recorder modules that handle 16 kHz mono int16 PCM chunks, stop recording on silence or max duration, and save tmp/input.wav.
acceptance: src/audio_input.py opens one reusable microphone stream configured for 16 kHz mono int16 PCM.
src/silence.py exposes is_silence(pcm_chunk: bytes, threshold: float = 500) using deterministic RMS logic.
src/recorder.py collects PCM chunks, stops on SILENCE_SECONDS or MAX_RECORD_SECONDS, and writes a valid WAV file.
Tests verify silence detection and WAV writing using synthetic PCM without requiring a real microphone.
Runtime errors from unavailable audio devices are logged with clear recovery guidance.

features.title: Implement Hey Jarvis wake-word detector
features.description: Wrap openWakeWord behind a small WakeWordDetector interface that accepts PCM chunks and returns true when the built-in hey jarvis wake-word score crosses the configured threshold.
acceptance: src/wake_word.py defines WakeWordDetector with __init__(threshold: float) and detect(pcm_chunk: bytes) -> bool.
The MVP default uses an openWakeWord built-in hey jarvis model and does not require a custom model file.
The detector keeps model loading separate from the main state machine and logs load or inference failures clearly.
Tests cover threshold behavior with a fake model without requiring real microphone input.
README notes that custom wake words are deferred to a later iteration.

features.title: Implement OpenAI transcription, chat, and TTS client
features.description: Add an OpenAI client boundary for speech-to-text, short chat responses with in-memory history, and text-to-speech output to tmp/output.mp3, with configurable model names and testable SDK interactions.
acceptance: src/openai_client.py exposes transcribe_audio(path: str) -> str, ask_chatgpt(text: str, history: list[dict]) -> str, and text_to_speech(text: str, output_path: str) -> None.
Model names for transcription, chat, and TTS are configurable with documented defaults.
The client keeps a short in-memory conversation history boundary suitable for the MVP.
Errors from missing credentials, API failures, or empty transcriptions are surfaced with clear messages.
Tests mock OpenAI SDK calls and verify request shape, returned text handling, and output file writing behavior without live API access.

features.title: Wire playback and main voice-assistant state machine
features.description: Implement macOS playback, the WAIT_WAKE to PLAYING state machine, and the python -m src.main entrypoint so the MVP can complete one Hey Jarvis question-answer loop and return to wake listening.
acceptance: src/player.py plays an audio file through afplay and reports playback failures clearly.
src/state_machine.py implements WAIT_WAKE, RECORDING, TRANSCRIBE, ASK_OPENAI, TTS, and PLAYING transitions with explicit logs.
src/main.py wires configuration, microphone stream, wake-word detection, recording, OpenAI client, TTS, playback, and return-to-WAIT_WAKE behavior.
A fake-backend smoke test proves the full state-machine path without microphone, OpenAI, or speaker access.
Manual README instructions describe how to run the real demo: user says Hey Jarvis, asks what two plus two is, hears the answer, and the app returns to wake listening.

features.title: Document setup, permissions, and post-MVP iterations
features.description: Finish user-facing documentation for local setup, macOS microphone permission, environment configuration, real-demo operation, troubleshooting, and deferred iterations for interruption, follow-up conversation, and custom wake words.
acceptance: README includes venv setup, dependency installation, .env creation, OPENAI_API_KEY configuration, and python -m src.main run instructions.
README explains macOS microphone permission and afplay requirements.
README documents the accepted MVP wake phrase Hey Jarvis and the first demo question.
README lists post-MVP TODOs for interrupting playback, six-second follow-up conversation, and custom wake-word model loading.
Root ./init.sh or tests verify that documented commands and module entrypoints stay in sync where practical.

features.title: Fix recoverable wake-word model setup
features.description: Fix the real Hey Jarvis wake-word path so macOS Python 3.11/3.12 users use the openWakeWord ONNX runtime path, can prepare the required ONNX models explicitly, and see diagnostic errors before starting the assistant.
acceptance: WakeWordDetector loads the built-in Hey Jarvis openWakeWord model with the ONNX inference framework on macOS.
A CLI command prepares the required openWakeWord Hey Jarvis and feature extractor model files without starting microphone capture.
Runtime diagnostics report missing onnxruntime or missing openWakeWord model files with an actionable preparation command.
README setup and troubleshooting document the ONNX wake-word preparation step.
Tests cover ONNX model loading arguments, wake-word preparation, diagnostics for missing model files, and documented CLI flags without downloading real models.

features.title: Prevent wake-listening microphone overflow during model startup
features.description: Fix the real wake-listening path so the ONNX wake-word model is loaded and warmed before microphone capture starts, and align microphone chunks with openWakeWord's 1280-sample prediction frame to reduce overflow and missed wake phrases.
acceptance: The real assistant preloads the WakeWordDetector model before opening the microphone stream.
The default microphone stream block size is 1280 frames to match openWakeWord's 80ms prediction frame at 16 kHz.
Runtime logs make the wake-word model preload phase visible before listening starts.
README troubleshooting explains that microphone overflow during WAIT_WAKE can mean wake-word model startup or audio processing fell behind.
Tests verify the preload-before-microphone order and the 1280-frame microphone default without requiring a real microphone.

features.title: Add wake-word debug probes
features.description: Add observable wake-word debugging paths so users can distinguish microphone input problems, low PCM levels, openWakeWord score issues, and threshold issues when the assistant remains in WAIT_WAKE.
acceptance: A CLI debug mode prints live microphone rms, peak, overflow, wake score, and threshold fields without invoking OpenAI or playback.
A CLI file-debug mode accepts a WAV file and reports wake-word scores for the saved audio without requiring a microphone.
WAKE_DEBUG=1 enables wake-score logging during normal WAIT_WAKE listening.
README documents how to use the debug probes and how to interpret common score and RMS outcomes.
Tests cover debug output shape, WAV-file scoring with generated fixtures, CLI parser flags, and WAKE_DEBUG behavior without requiring a physical microphone.

features.title: Add wake debug capture replay
features.description: Add a reproducible wake-word debug workflow that saves live microphone PCM to a WAV file, reports higher-precision wake scores, and summarizes maximum observed scores so users can replay the exact audio that failed detection.
acceptance: Live wake debug supports an explicit output flag that writes the scored microphone chunks to a mono 16 kHz 16-bit WAV file without invoking OpenAI or playback.

Live and file debug output report wake scores with enough precision to distinguish tiny non-zero values from true zeros and include a summary with frame count, max score, threshold, and detected frame count.
Wake-file replay handles short or final partial chunks deterministically instead of silently dropping them.
README documents the record-and-replay workflow and warns that tmp/input.wav is not created by wake-debug unless the user requests a debug output file.
Tests cover the parser flag, saved debug WAV shape, precise score formatting, summary metrics, and short WAV replay using fakes or generated fixtures.

features.title: Switch wake word to Alexa
features.description: Replace the unreliable built-in Hey Jarvis wake-word model with openWakeWord's built-in Alexa model as the MVP default wake phrase, including model preparation, diagnostics, documentation, and tests.
acceptance: The default wake phrase and wake-word model constants use Alexa and the openWakeWord alexa model key.
WakeWordDetector loads the Alexa model with the ONNX inference framework and extracts scores from the Alexa prediction key.
Wake-word preparation and diagnostics prepare and check the Alexa ONNX model assets together with required feature models.
README and .env.example document Alexa as the accepted wake phrase and update wake-debug examples accordingly.
Tests cover loader arguments, score-key extraction, preparation paths, diagnostics, documentation, and recovery checks without requiring a physical microphone.

features.title: Switch wake-word runtime to Porcupine
features.description: Record the openWakeWord blocker discovered with both Hey Jarvis and Alexa, remove openWakeWord/ONNX as the active wake-word runtime, and replace it with a Picovoice Porcupine detector configured through a user-provided AccessKey and built-in keyword.
acceptance: Progress or run evidence records that openWakeWord blocked the MVP after both Hey Jarvis and Alexa manual tests failed to wake reliably.
The active WakeWordDetector uses pvporcupine with a configured built-in keyword, sensitivity, AccessKey, engine frame_length, and engine sample_rate instead of openWakeWord ONNX models.
Runtime diagnostics and setup documentation require pvporcupine and PICOVOICE_ACCESS_KEY and no longer require openWakeWord, onnxruntime, or ONNX model preparation for the active path.
Wake debug and wake-file replay remain available with Porcupine-compatible frame sizing and deterministic detection output without invoking OpenAI or playback.

Focused tests cover Porcupine loader arguments, PCM conversion, frame-size validation, detector cleanup, config/diagnostics, documentation, and recovery checks without a real microphone or Picovoice AccessKey.

features.title: Restore Alexa wake-word runtime
features.description: Restore the active wake-word runtime to the F012 Alexa/openWakeWord ONNX path because Picovoice Porcupine requires a PICOVOICE_ACCESS_KEY that the user cannot currently obtain.
acceptance: Progress or run evidence records the Porcupine AccessKey/account capability gap and the decision to restore Alexa.
The active WakeWordDetector again uses openWakeWord with the Alexa model, ONNX inference framework, Alexa score key extraction, and 1280-sample prediction frames.

Runtime diagnostics, requirements, README, and .env.example no longer require pvporcupine or PICOVOICE_ACCESS_KEY for the active path and again document openWakeWord, onnxruntime, and prepare-wake-word.
Wake debug and wake-file replay use openWakeWord-compatible 1280-sample frame sizing and score/threshold output without invoking OpenAI or playback.
Focused tests cover Alexa loader arguments, ONNX preparation paths, diagnostics, documentation, frame sizing, and recovery checks without a real microphone or live model download.

features.title: Switch Alexa openWakeWord runtime to TFLite
features.description: Switch the active Alexa/openWakeWord wake-word path from ONNX to configurable TFLite inference on macOS, with framework-aware configuration, preparation, diagnostics, debug output, and a macOS ARM64 guard against silently using the known-broken ONNX path.
acceptance: Configuration loads and documents WAKE_BACKEND=openwakeword, WAKE_MODEL=alexa, WAKE_INFERENCE_FRAMEWORK=tflite, and WAKE_THRESHOLD=0.5, with validation for supported wake backends and inference frameworks.

WakeWordDetector receives the configured model name, threshold, and inference framework, passes inference_framework through to openwakeword.model.Model, extracts scores from the configured model key or a safe fallback, and defaults to Alexa/TFLite for the active path.
Wake-word preparation and diagnostics are framework-aware: TFLite checks and prepares .tflite assets and TFLite runtime capability, while ONNX remains explicit and is not used by default.
Live/file wake debug and scripts/debug_oww_file.py print the requested model, selected inference framework, loaded model keys, and per-key maximum scores so ONNX and TFLite runs cannot be confused.
On macOS ARM64, selecting WAKE_INFERENCE_FRAMEWORK=onnx fails fast with an actionable error explaining the known near-zero openWakeWord ONNX scores and instructing the user to use TFLite.

README, .env.example, requirements, and focused tests cover the TFLite default, macOS ARM64 ONNX guard, framework-specific preparation/diagnostics, debug output metadata, and recovery checks without real microphone access or live model downloads.

features.title: Keep assistant alive after empty transcription
features.description: Fix the real assistant loop so an empty OpenAI transcription or other OpenAI client error after a wake event is logged as a recoverable loop failure and returns to WAIT_WAKE instead of crashing the long-running process.
acceptance: If transcription raises OpenAIClientError, including empty transcription text, the state machine logs the failure and returns to WAIT_WAKE without calling chat, TTS, or playback.
OpenAIClientError from chat completion or text-to-speech is also handled as a recoverable loop failure that returns to WAIT_WAKE without exiting the process.
Unexpected non-OpenAI exceptions are not broadly swallowed by the state machine.
Focused tests cover empty transcription recovery and prove successful loops still complete normally.
Progress or run evidence records the user-observed traceback and the manual fallback verification.

features.title: Suppress post-playback false wake detection
features.description: Fix the real assistant loop so answer playback residue, stale microphone chunks, or immediate overflow after PLAYING do not trigger a new wake event when the user has not spoken.
acceptance: After playback finishes, the state machine consumes a configurable post-playback microphone cooldown window without invoking wake detection before declaring WAIT_WAKE ready.
Wake detection requires a configurable number of consecutive positive wake frames so a single residual or overflowed frame does not enter RECORDING.
The default cooldown and confirmation settings are loaded from documented environment variables and keep the fake-backend smoke path deterministic.
Focused tests simulate playback residue and overflowed microphone chunks without real hardware and prove they are ignored after PLAYING.
README, DEPLOYMENT, MANUAL_TESTING, progress, and run evidence document the user-observed failure and the manual retest path.

features.title: Gate post-playback wake on observed quiet
features.description: Fix the remaining post-playback false wake path by keeping wake decisions suppressed until the microphone has produced a configurable quiet window after playback, not just until a fixed cooldown expires.
acceptance: Post-playback suppression first drains the fixed cooldown and then waits for configurable consecutive quiet audio before logging that WAIT_WAKE is ready.
Suppressed post-playback audio advances the wake detector state but never triggers RECORDING, even when residual chunks score as wake-positive after the fixed cooldown.
The quiet-window duration, quiet RMS threshold, and maximum suppression duration are loaded from documented environment variables with validation.
Focused tests simulate residual wake-positive playback audio after the cooldown followed by quiet audio and prove the assistant does not enter a second RECORDING loop.
README, DEPLOYMENT, MANUAL_TESTING, progress, and run evidence document the second observed failure and the manual retest path.

features.title: Configure TTS vibe and speed
features.description: Expose OpenAI text-to-speech style instructions and generated audio speed through documented environment configuration so users can approximate OpenAI.fm vibe settings from the API-backed assistant.
acceptance: Configuration loads optional TTS_INSTRUCTIONS and validated TTS_SPEED settings with documented defaults that preserve existing behavior.
OpenAIClient.text_to_speech sends voice, optional instructions, and speed to the OpenAI speech endpoint without requiring live API calls in tests.
Invalid TTS_SPEED values below 0.25, above 4.0, or non-numeric are reported as configuration errors before runtime.
.env.example, README, and DEPLOYMENT explain how OpenAI.fm-style vibe maps to TTS_INSTRUCTIONS rather than a separate API parameter.
Focused tests cover configuration defaults, overrides, invalid speed, TTS request shape, and documentation key coverage.

features.title: Restore Hey Jarvis TFLite wake word
features.description: Replace the active Alexa/openWakeWord default with the user-validated built-in Hey Jarvis TFLite model and phrase, keeping the existing openWakeWord/TFLite runtime, diagnostics, debug tooling, documentation, and tests aligned.
acceptance: Configuration defaults and .env.example use WAKE_BACKEND=openwakeword, WAKE_MODEL=hey_jarvis, WAKE_INFERENCE_FRAMEWORK=tflite, WAKE_PHRASE=hey jarvis, and WAKE_THRESHOLD=0.5.
WakeWordDetector defaults to the hey_jarvis openWakeWord model, extracts the hey_jarvis score key, remains configurable for other built-in models, and keeps the macOS ARM64 ONNX guard.
Wake-word preparation, diagnostics, live/file debug metadata, runtime logs, and fake-backend smoke output refer to the configured Hey Jarvis model and phrase rather than hard-coded Alexa text.
README, DEPLOYMENT, and MANUAL_TESTING document Hey Jarvis as the accepted wake phrase, including prepare-wake-word, diagnose, wake-debug, wake-file, and two-plus-two demo flows.

Focused tests cover the Hey Jarvis defaults, model loader arguments, model preparation paths, debug metadata, documentation coverage, and recovery checks without requiring live microphone or OpenAI access.

features.title: Add wake acknowledgement before recording
features.description: Play a short pre-generated acknowledgement after the Hey Jarvis wake word before recording the user's actual question, with configuration, preparation, diagnostics, microphone-drain protection, documentation, and tests.
acceptance: Configuration loads documented wake acknowledgement settings, including enabled state, acknowledgement text defaulting to "在呢", acknowledgement audio path defaulting to tmp/ack.mp3, and a validated microphone-drain duration before question recording.

A CLI preparation path generates the acknowledgement audio once at the configured path through the existing OpenAI TTS boundary, while normal wake handling reuses the local file and does not call TTS for the acknowledgement on every wake event.

Diagnostics and real startup report a missing acknowledgement audio file with actionable preparation guidance when acknowledgement playback is enabled, without hiding the error until after wake detection.

After a confirmed wake, the state machine plays the configured acknowledgement, drains acknowledgement playback residue from the microphone, then starts the existing recorder so silence and max-duration stop behavior remain unchanged and acknowledgement audio is not transcribed as the user's question.

Focused tests and fake-backend smoke coverage verify the new WAIT_WAKE -> ACK_PLAYING -> RECORDING flow, missing-file handling, no per-wake acknowledgement TTS call, documentation coverage, and final recovery through ./init.sh without real microphone, speaker, or live OpenAI access.

features.title: Add structured tool routing foundation
features.description: Add a deterministic structured-tool routing layer between transcription and answer generation so the assistant can identify realtime-sensitive questions, answer local time and simple calculator requests without model guessing, and refuse unsupported realtime data until a configured provider exists.
acceptance: src/tools defines ToolRoute and ToolResult schemas, a deterministic rule-based router, local time and safe calculator tools, and explicit not-configured results for planned weather, FX, and stock tools without adding network calls.

The router classifies calculator, time, weather, stock, FX, none, and unsupported realtime-sensitive requests with tested handling for ambiguous phrases such as "苹果怎么样" and unsupported realtime phrases such as "今天有什么新闻".

The post-transcription answer path uses the structured routing boundary when tools are enabled, returns local tool answers for time/calculator, returns configured tool failure messages for unimplemented providers, and does not fall back to chat memory for unsupported realtime-sensitive questions.

A text debug mode such as python -m src.main --text "现在几点" prints the input, route, params, tool result summary, and final answer without microphone, wake-word detection, TTS, playback, OpenAI, or external network access.

.env.example, README or manual testing docs, and focused tests cover ENABLE_TOOLS, router debug behavior, supported versus unsupported realtime tool categories, safe calculator parsing, local time output, and final recovery through ./init.sh.

features.title: Add shared network tool provider infrastructure
features.description: Add a small shared provider/HTTP boundary for network-backed structured tools, including provider configuration, timeout and JSON handling, structured recoverable errors, diagnostics/text-debug surfacing, and mocked tests without implementing weather, FX, or stock provider behavior yet.
acceptance: Configuration loads documented provider settings and timeout defaults, including WEATHER_PROVIDER, FX_PROVIDER, STOCK_PROVIDER, TOOL_HTTP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, DEFAULT_LOCATION, DEFAULT_BASE_CURRENCY, and optional FINNHUB_API_KEY without logging secrets.

A shared tools HTTP/provider helper performs JSON GET requests with query parameters and timeout handling, and maps HTTP status, timeout, network, and malformed JSON failures into structured tool/provider errors without crashing the assistant.

Diagnostics or text-debug output surfaces provider configuration and missing stock-quote credentials clearly without invoking microphone, wake-word detection, TTS, playback, OpenAI, or live network calls.
Focused tests mock the HTTP boundary and cover success, HTTP errors, timeouts, malformed JSON, network exceptions, provider config defaults, invalid timeout values, and missing credential messaging.
.env.example, README or manual testing docs, and final ./init.sh recovery verification cover the provider settings, no-live-network automated-test rule, and manual real-provider smoke expectations.

features.title: Implement Open-Meteo weather tool
features.description: Replace the weather not-configured result with an Open-Meteo-backed provider that resolves locations, fetches current/today/tomorrow forecast data, and returns short structured weather answers with source and freshness metadata.
acceptance: Weather routing extracts practical location and current/today/tomorrow intent, uses DEFAULT_LOCATION when the user omits a location, and preserves unsupported realtime guards for non-weather topics.
The weather provider resolves city names through Open-Meteo geocoding and calls the Open-Meteo forecast endpoint for current, hourly, or daily fields needed for current, today, and tomorrow answers.

Successful ToolResult data includes normalized location, source=open-meteo, observation or forecast time, freshness wording, temperature, apparent temperature or weather code where available, and precipitation or rain probability context.
No geocoding match, missing forecast fields, provider HTTP failures, and malformed provider data return structured weather failures and do not fall back to chat speculation.

Focused tests mock geocoding and forecast responses, cover success and failure paths, verify text-debug/answer-path behavior, update documentation examples, and pass final ./init.sh recovery verification.

features.title: Implement Frankfurter FX tool
features.description: Replace the FX not-configured result with a Frankfurter-backed exchange-rate provider that normalizes amount/base/quote requests, calculates conversions locally, and returns concise reference-rate answers.
acceptance: FX routing extracts amount, base currency, and quote currency from common English and Chinese aliases, including at least USD, SGD, CNY, EUR, JPY, HKD, GBP, and AUD, with documented defaults when one side is omitted.

The FX provider calls Frankfurter's rate endpoint for a single currency pair, calculates converted amounts locally, and returns rate, converted amount, rate date, source=frankfurter, and reference-rate freshness metadata.
Answers clearly distinguish provider reference rates from bank cash rates or executable trading quotes while staying short enough for TTS.
Unsupported currencies, same-currency requests, missing rate fields, provider HTTP failures, and malformed provider data return structured FX failures and do not fall back to chat speculation.

Focused tests mock Frankfurter responses, cover parsing aliases, rounding, success and failure paths, verify text-debug/answer-path behavior, update documentation examples, and pass final ./init.sh recovery verification.

features.title: Implement Finnhub stock quote tool
features.description: Replace the stock not-configured result with a Finnhub-backed stock quote provider that uses a configured API key, conservative symbol extraction, and concise quote answers with market-data caveats.
acceptance: Stock routing extracts uppercase ticker symbols and a small conservative company-name alias map, while preserving ambiguity handling for ordinary phrases such as 苹果怎么样 that should not become stock quote requests.
Configuration and diagnostics load FINNHUB_API_KEY as an optional secret, report missing credentials clearly for stock quotes, and never print or log the key value.

The stock provider calls Finnhub's quote endpoint and maps current price, change, percent change, high, low, open, previous close, timestamp, source=finnhub, and freshness or delay wording into structured ToolResult data.
Missing API key, unknown symbols, zero or missing current price, provider HTTP failures, and malformed provider data return structured stock failures and do not fall back to chat speculation.

Focused tests mock Finnhub responses, cover aliases, missing key, unknown symbols, success and failure paths, verify text-debug/answer-path behavior, update documentation examples, and pass final ./init.sh recovery verification.

features.title: Naturalize structured tool answers with LLM
features.description: Add a separate OpenAI naturalization pass that turns successful provider-backed ToolResult data into more natural spoken answers while keeping provider data stable, inspectable, and authoritative.
acceptance: Configuration documents and loads a toggle for tool-answer naturalization, defaulting to enabled for successful provider-backed tool results while preserving a deterministic raw-answer fallback.

Successful weather, FX, and stock ToolResult values can be passed to a dedicated OpenAI naturalization boundary that receives only the user question, route metadata, raw answer, summary, and non-secret structured data, with prompt instructions to preserve numbers, units, sources, timestamps, caveats, and advice disclaimers.

Provider failures, missing credentials, not-configured results, realtime refusals, local calculator/time answers, disabled naturalization, empty LLM output, and recoverable OpenAI errors bypass naturalization and do not fall back to chat speculation.
Text debug remains dependency-free and exposes the raw tool answer plus naturalization status without requiring OpenAI credentials or live network calls.

Focused tests use fake OpenAI clients and mocked provider results to verify request shape, fallback behavior, no chat-history pollution, no secret leakage, documentation coverage, and final ./init.sh recovery verification.

features.title: Fix ambiguous weather location handling
features.description: Fix weather routing so relative or ambiguous location phrases fall back to DEFAULT_LOCATION instead of being sent to Open-Meteo geocoding as concrete places, and make provider failures log safe route context for diagnosis.
acceptance: Weather routing preserves concrete English and Chinese locations such as Tokyo or 东京 while treating relative phrases such as here, current location, 这里, 这边, 本地, and nearby as omitted locations.

Weather requests with omitted or relative locations use configured DEFAULT_LOCATION through the existing Open-Meteo provider path without adding GPS, OS location access, or live-network automated tests.
Structured provider error ToolResult data retains safe route context such as query, intent, attempted location, provider_error, and status_code where available, without including secrets.
State-machine provider-error logs include safe tool route params and result data so future no_location_match failures reveal the attempted location without requiring TOOL_ROUTER_DEBUG.
Focused mocked tests cover relative-location fallback, concrete-location preservation, provider-error context, weather answer-path behavior, and final ./init.sh recovery verification.

features.title: Cancel false wakes before AI response
features.description: Add a post-wake ARMED intent-confirmation state and local speech/transcript gates so false or accidental wake events return quietly to WAIT_WAKE instead of completing a full OpenAI answer and TTS playback cycle.
acceptance: Configuration loads and documents conservative defaults for the armed no-speech timeout, armed voice threshold, minimum valid speech duration, minimum transcript length, and English/Chinese cancel phrases without adding new runtime dependencies.

After wake detection and optional acknowledgement playback/drain, the state machine enters ARMED and returns to WAIT_WAKE without recording, transcription, chat/tool routing, TTS, playback, or chat-history changes when no speech is detected before the configured timeout.

When speech is detected within ARMED, the existing successful voice loop still records the user request, transcribes it, routes or asks OpenAI, synthesizes speech, plays the answer, and applies existing post-playback suppression.

Too-short or effectively silent recordings, empty or filler transcripts, and configured cancel phrases such as 取消, 没事, 不用了, 算了, stop, cancel, and never mind are treated as local cancellation and return to WAIT_WAKE without AI answer generation or TTS playback.

Focused fake-audio tests, documentation tests, fake-backend smoke coverage, run evidence, and final ./init.sh recovery verification prove false wakes cancel quietly and normal requests still work without real microphone, speaker, OpenAI, or live network access.

features.title: Make cancel phrases robust in noisy environments
features.description: Improve local cancellation so short cancel phrases still return to WAIT_WAKE when transcription includes trailing noise artifacts, while guarding against legitimate requests that merely begin with a cancel word.
acceptance: Transcript cancellation handles exact configured cancel phrases and conservative short cancel-prefixed variants such as 没事了, 没事不用了, 没事 谢谢, 没事 后面有声音, 取消吧, 算了算了, stop, cancel, and never mind without calling chat/tool routing, TTS, playback, or mutating chat history.
Legitimate requests that include a cancel word but continue into a real command, such as 没事的话帮我查天气 or 取消我明天的闹钟, are not locally cancelled by the noisy-cancel heuristic.
Local cancellation logs include enough safe context to diagnose match behavior, such as normalized transcript and match mode, without logging secrets or audio data.
The implementation remains deterministic and dependency-free, does not add VAD, streaming STT, wake-word changes, recorder threshold changes, or live-network/audio requirements to automated tests.

Focused tests cover exact cancel, noisy short cancel variants, non-cancel guard phrases, state-machine no-chat/no-TTS/no-history behavior, documentation/manual-test updates, and final ./init.sh recovery verification.

features.title: Suppress wake detection after local cancellation
features.description: Prevent local cancellation paths such as cancel phrases or armed no-speech timeouts from immediately re-entering wake detection on residual acknowledgement, user, or wake-model audio and looping through acknowledgement playback.
acceptance: After transcript-level local cancellation such as 算了算了, the assistant suppresses wake detection and waits for observed quiet before becoming wake-ready, so wake-positive residual chunks do not cause an immediate second ACK_PLAYING cycle.

After ARMED no-speech local cancellation, the same post-cancel suppression prevents repeated wake/acknowledgement loops when residual wake-positive chunks remain in the microphone stream or wake detector state.

The fix preserves F029/F030 cancellation guarantees: local cancellation still skips chat/tool routing, answer TTS, answer playback, and chat-history mutation, and normal successful answer playback still uses the existing post-playback suppression path.
Suppression behavior is logged with safe context such as cancellation reason, discarded chunk counts, quiet-gate status, and maximum suppressed wake score, without logging secrets or raw audio.

Focused fake-audio tests and documentation/manual-test updates cover the reported hey jarvis -> acknowledgement -> 算了算了 loop, no-speech cancellation loops, later intentional wake after quiet, and final ./init.sh recovery verification without live microphone, OpenAI, speaker, or network access.

features.title: Cover common spoken Chinese cancel variants
features.description: Expand deterministic local cancellation to common spoken Chinese cancel variants that real STT can produce, such as 不用啦, 不用不用了, 不要了, 没事儿, and 没事没事儿, while preserving command-like guard phrases and adding safe diagnostics for missed short transcripts.
acceptance: Transcript-level cancellation handles common short Chinese spoken cancel variants including 不用了, 不用啦, 不用不用, 不用不用了, 不用了谢谢, 不要了, 没事儿, 没事没事儿, and 没事儿没事儿 without calling chat/tool routing, answer TTS, playback, or mutating chat history.
Command-like continuations that begin with or contain cancel-like words, such as 不用了帮我查天气, 没事的话帮我查天气, 取消我明天的闹钟, and 不要取消我明天的闹钟, are not locally cancelled by the expanded matcher.
When a short transcript is not locally cancelled, logs include safe diagnostic context such as normalized transcript, compact form, and match decision, without logging secrets or audio data.

The implementation remains deterministic and dependency-free, does not add VAD, streaming STT, wake-word changes, recorder threshold changes, live-network/audio requirements, or general NLP intent classification.

Focused tests and documentation/manual-test updates cover colloquial cancel variants, command guards, no-chat/no-TTS/no-playback/no-history behavior, F031 post-cancellation path compatibility, and final ./init.sh recovery verification.

features.title: Stop recording promptly in steady background noise
features.description: Improve recorder end-of-speech detection so short user requests stop near SILENCE_SECONDS despite low or moderate steady background noise, instead of waiting until MAX_RECORD_SECONDS.
acceptance: Configuration loads and documents a RECORDING_SILENCE_RMS setting with a conservative default near the existing ARMED voice threshold, supports environment overrides, and rejects invalid negative values.

Question recording passes the configured recording silence threshold from settings into the recorder without changing wake-word detection, ARMED speech detection, transcription, chat/tool routing, TTS, or playback behavior.

Recorder silence stopping uses a window-tolerant rule so steady background noise below the configured threshold and occasional noisy chunks do not reset end-of-speech indefinitely, while speech-like chunks still extend recording.

MAX_RECORD_SECONDS remains a safety cap for genuinely non-silent input, and recording results/logs preserve clear stopped_by values such as silence and max_duration without logging raw audio or secrets.

Focused config, recorder, state-machine wiring, documentation/manual-test tests, synthetic PCM fixtures, and final ./init.sh recovery verification prove 4-5 second utterances stop promptly in noisy-background scenarios without live microphone, OpenAI, speaker, or network access.

features.title: Route traditional Chinese local tool requests
features.description: Fix deterministic local-tool routing so traditional Chinese STT variants such as 現在幾點了 and 100減20是多少 route to the local time or calculator tools instead of falling through to general OpenAI chat.
acceptance: Time routing recognizes common traditional Chinese time phrases including 現在幾點了, 幾點了, and 現在時間 while preserving existing simplified Chinese, English, and Japanese time markers.
Calculator routing recognizes digit-based traditional Chinese arithmetic such as 100減20是多少 while preserving existing symbolic, English, and simplified Chinese operator behavior.

Traditional Chinese local-tool requests produce route=time/tool=local_time or route=calculator/tool=safe_calculator through the text-debug CLI, with local ToolResult answers and no external provider requirement.
The normal answer path after transcription uses local tools for traditional Chinese time and calculator requests and does not call ask_chatgpt or mutate chat history for those routed requests.

The fix stays narrowly scoped to deterministic local-tool routing and does not change wake-word detection, ARMED timing, recording thresholds, transcription settings, provider-backed tools, local time answer formatting, calculator safety rules, or add broad Chinese script conversion.
Focused router/text-debug/answer-path tests and final ./init.sh recovery verification pass without live microphone, OpenAI chat, speaker, or network access.

features.title: Confirm ARMED speech with adaptive pre-roll
features.description: Replace single-chunk ARMED speech triggering with adaptive noise-floor speech confirmation over a recent voiced window, preserve about 500ms of pre-roll audio when recording starts, and add structured ARMED diagnostics plus local safety gates for short, empty, filler, or acknowledgement-only recordings.
acceptance: ARMED maintains a recent pre-roll ring buffer and starts recording with the actual buffered audio plus subsequent microphone chunks so sustained-speech confirmation does not drop the beginning of the user's utterance.

ARMED uses deterministic multi-chunk speech confirmation based on a recent voiced window, rejecting overflowed and clipped chunks and requiring RMS to meet max(ARMED_MIN_RMS, noise_floor * ARMED_SNR_MULTIPLIER) instead of triggering from one RMS-above-threshold chunk.

ARMED logs structured armed_summary and armed_trigger context including PCM duration, chunks, max_rms, max_peak, overflow_chunks, voiced_chunks or voiced_window, threshold/dynamic threshold, noise_floor, result, and pre-roll duration/counts without logging raw audio or secrets.

Configuration and documentation expose the ARMED minimum RMS, SNR multiplier, voiced-window duration/ratio, clipped-peak rejection, and pre-roll duration with validated defaults that preserve ordinary quiet speech better than a static RMS 5000 threshold.

Even if ARMED misfires, short speech duration below the configured minimum, empty STT, filler text, or acknowledgement-only text such as 在呢 locally cancels before chat/tool routing, answer TTS, playback, or chat-history mutation.

Focused config/state-machine/documentation tests and final ./init.sh recovery verification cover adaptive thresholding, overflow/clipping rejection, pre-roll preservation, diagnostic logs, and downstream cancellation without live microphone, OpenAI, speaker, or network access.

features.title: Guard ARMED startup and acknowledgement boundary
features.description: Prevent ARMED cold-start false triggers until a configurable noise baseline is ready, require current speech when configured, and replace blind acknowledgement draining with a conservative bounded guard that can preserve immediate user-speech pre-roll.
acceptance: Configuration loads, validates, and documents ARMED_BASELINE_SECONDS=0.30, ARMED_BASELINE_MIN_CHUNKS=3, ARMED_REQUIRE_BASELINE=true, and ARMED_LAST_CHUNK_MUST_BE_VOICED=true while preserving ARMED_VOICE_RMS as the legacy ARMED_MIN_RMS fallback.

ARMED preserves all baseline-period audio in pre-roll but cannot trigger until both baseline elapsed audio and valid non-overflow chunk count are ready when required; overflowed and clipped chunks cannot drive voice decisions, and only valid dynamically non-voiced chunks update noise samples.

ARMED optionally requires the latest chunk to be voiced, and armed_trigger/armed_summary logs include baseline_ready, baseline_chunks, baseline_seconds, noise_floor, dynamic_threshold, and the existing result markers.

Configuration loads, validates, and documents ACK_GUARD_ENABLED=true, ACK_GUARD_SECONDS=0.60, ACK_GUARD_MIN_QUIET_SECONDS=0.16, ACK_GUARD_QUIET_RMS=600, and ACK_GUARD_MAX_BUFFER_SECONDS=1.00; the bounded guard suppresses acknowledgement residue, logs discarded/preserved counts and quiet/max metrics, and passes only a conservative late non-quiet tail into ARMED pre-roll.

A wake followed by acknowledgement residue and silence cancels locally as no_speech_after_wake without recording, transcription, chat/tool routing, answer TTS, or answer playback, while immediate speech near the acknowledgement boundary can be preserved into eventual recording without guard chunks automatically forcing ARMED trigger.

Focused configuration, state-machine, documentation, dry-run, fake-backend, diagnose, full unittest, and final ./init.sh verification pass without VAD, new dependencies, recorder endpointing changes, live audio, OpenAI, speaker, or network access.

features.title: Require a safe post-ACK boundary
features.description: Separate acknowledgement residue suppression from ARMED user-speech detection so guarded ACK flows require observed quiet and useful noise seeds before triggering, exclude clipped or overflowed residue from pre-roll, and cancel locally on bounded suppression timeout.
acceptance: Guarded ACK-enabled flow uses an explicit post-ACK boundary result with quiet_observed, suppressed/preserved/noise-seed chunks, RMS/peak, overflow/clipped counts, and timeout state; it continues suppression up to ACK_GUARD_MAX_BUFFER_SECONDS and locally cancels without recording or OpenAI when no safe quiet boundary is reached.

Post-ACK ARMED cannot trigger while post_ack_quiet_observed=false or while its useful noise floor has no samples; trigger and summary logs expose post-ACK quiet/suppression metrics, noise_floor_has_samples, and baseline readiness timing/count context without removing existing result markers.
Clipped or overflowed post-ACK chunks clear candidate pre-roll and never enter tmp/input.wav; after quiet is observed, normal ARMED pre-roll starts cleanly and preserves the first user speech chunk.
ACK-disabled immediate speech retains F036 behavior, and disabling ACK_GUARD retains the documented legacy drain/ordinary ARMED compatibility path.

Defaults and docs use ACK_GUARD_SECONDS=0.80, ACK_GUARD_MIN_QUIET_SECONDS=0.16, ACK_GUARD_QUIET_RMS=900, and ACK_GUARD_MAX_BUFFER_SECONDS=1.50, with guidance for clipped echo to lower playback volume or shorten the acknowledgement.

Focused config/state-machine/docs regressions, full unittest discovery, dry-run, fake-backend, diagnose execution, and final ./init.sh pass without VAD, recorder endpointing changes, live audio, OpenAI, speaker, or network.

features.title: Preserve clipped post-ACK user speech
features.description: Remove the unused ACK_GUARD_SECONDS setting and stop post-boundary clipped or overflowed chunks from clearing earlier safe ARMED pre-roll, preserving clipped user speech as audio while excluding it from trigger and noise decisions.
acceptance: ACK_GUARD_SECONDS and ack_guard_seconds are removed from tracked defaults, Settings, loading, examples, README, manual guidance, tests, and post-ACK logs; ACK_GUARD_MAX_BUFFER_SECONDS remains the single documented bounded suppression timeout.

Before the verified quiet boundary, clipped/overflowed ACK residue continues resetting quiet/noise candidates and never enters recording; no-quiet guarded flow still cancels locally without ARMED or OpenAI.

After the quiet boundary, overflowed ARMED chunks are omitted individually and clipped chunks are retained in bounded recording pre-roll, while neither invalid type clears earlier safe pre-roll or counts as voiced/noise-floor evidence.

A synthetic question with valid speech, clipped middle chunks, and later valid voiced chunks triggers recording with the initial speech and clipped audio still present, preventing the observed configured-800ms pre-roll from collapsing to only the final 240ms tail.
ACK-disabled immediate speech and F038 post-ACK diagnostics/baseline safety remain compatible, with useful pre-roll metrics that expose retained duration/counts.

Focused config/state-machine/docs tests, full unittest discovery, dry-run, fake-backend, diagnose execution, and final ./init.sh pass without VAD, recorder endpointing changes, live audio, OpenAI, speaker, or network.

features.title: Add optional VAD-gated audio handling
features.description: Add an optional local WebRTC VAD abstraction, gate ARMED on energy plus voice evidence, optionally forward a wake-model VAD threshold, and use VAD-aware recording endpoint hysteresis without changing default disabled behavior.
acceptance: A new project-owned VAD module provides a neutral DisabledVad and lazily loaded WebRtcVadDetector that validates supported sample rates, splits mono int16 PCM into 20ms frames, ignores incomplete trailing data deterministically, reports voiced ratio/counts, and raises actionable errors when the configured optional dependency is unavailable.

Configuration validates and documents VAD_BACKEND=disabled|webrtc, VAD_MODE=0..3, ARMED_VAD_REQUIRED_RATIO=0.50, ARMED_VAD_MIN_FRAMES=2, RECORDING_VAD_ENABLED=false, RECORDING_VAD_END_RATIO=0.25, RECORDING_VAD_SPEECH_RATIO=0.50, RECORDING_HANGOVER_SECONDS=0.30, RECORDING_END_SILENCE_SECONDS with SILENCE_SECONDS fallback, and optional WAKE_VAD_THRESHOLD while preserving existing settings.

When VAD is enabled, ARMED requires baseline readiness, energy, and configured VAD ratio/frame evidence; high-RMS non-voice cancels as no_speech_after_wake without recording or OpenAI, valid energy plus speech triggers recording, and armed_trigger/armed_summary expose useful non-spammy VAD diagnostics. Disabled VAD preserves the merged PR1 behavior.

WakeWordDetector passes vad_threshold to openWakeWord Model only when WAKE_VAD_THRESHOLD is configured, preserves the prior constructor arguments when unset, and raises a clear WakeWordError if a configured threshold is unsupported by the installed openWakeWord version.

record_to_wav remains backward compatible and, when recording VAD is enabled, preserves speech after short pauses, stops on sustained RMS-low/VAD-low non-voice before max duration, retains silence/max_duration/source_exhausted outcomes, and keeps maximum duration safety. State-machine wiring passes VAD only when configured.

README, .env.example, diagnostics, and MANUAL_TESTING explain optional installation and cover non-speech noise, background speech, and immediate-request tests; focused VAD/config/ARMED/wake/recorder/docs tests plus dry-run, fake-backend, diagnose, full unittest, and final ./init.sh pass without live audio, OpenAI, speaker, or network.

features.title: Drain microphone while wake acknowledgement plays
features.description: Make acknowledgement playback observable and continuously consume microphone input during playback so stale speaker echo and overflowed buffers do not reach post-ACK processing.
acceptance: The macOS player exposes a testable non-blocking or observable playback handle with deterministic running/completion/wait behavior and preserves actionable playback failures, while ordinary answer playback remains synchronously compatible.

During ACK_PLAYING the state machine starts acknowledgement playback and repeatedly reads and discards microphone chunks until playback completes, including discarding the final chunk that can overlap completion; no drained chunk can enter wake detection, ARMED, recording pre-roll, transcription, or OpenAI.

ACK playback drain logs bounded safe metrics including drained chunk count, overflow/clipped counts, maximum RMS/peak, and completion/failure state without raw audio or secrets, and it leaves no orphaned playback process or unbounded worker.

Deterministic fakes prove multiple acknowledgement/overflow chunks are consumed during playback and the next post-playback read comes from current audio; ACK-disabled, synchronous answer-playback, and fake-backend flows remain compatible.

Focused player/state-machine tests, full unittest discovery, dry-run, fake-backend, diagnose, documentation/manual checks, and final ./init.sh pass without a real microphone, speaker, afplay process, OpenAI, or network.

features.title: Preserve immediate speech after synchronized acknowledgement
features.description: Use the synchronized ACK drain to hand live post-playback audio directly into protected ARMED pre-roll, avoiding mandatory quiet suppression of an immediate question while retaining safe fallback behavior.
acceptance: After a verified F040 playback-time drain, the chunk overlapping playback completion is quarantined and subsequent live post-ACK chunks enter bounded ARMED pre-roll immediately instead of requiring ACK_GUARD_MIN_QUIET_SECONDS of silence before speech can be retained.

Immediate post-ACK speech such as 一加一等于几 is captured with its prefix intact and can trigger recording only through valid baseline, energy, rolling-voice, latest-chunk, and optional VAD evidence; overflowed or clipped chunks never count as voice or noise evidence.

Acknowledgement-only residue, silence, an unsafe overlap chunk, or failed drain synchronization cannot trigger recording or OpenAI; silence cancels locally and unsafe synchronization falls back to the existing bounded conservative quiet-boundary path.

ACK-disabled, guard-disabled, VAD-disabled, optional-VAD, F039 clipped-pre-roll, post-cancellation, post-playback, and fake-backend compatibility paths remain deterministic with useful synchronized-handoff diagnostics.

Focused synthetic tests, five-cycle fake stability, full unittest discovery, dry-run, fake-backend, diagnose, documentation/manual checks, final ./init.sh, and real-device immediate-question retesting pass without ACK-boundary timeout or prefix loss.

features.title: Route personal US watchlist company names
features.description: Expand deterministic stock aliases to the user's supplied US watchlist, including SpaceX/SPCX and common English and Chinese names, while preserving conservative stock intent and the existing Finnhub quote path.
acceptance: The stock router deterministically maps English and common Simplified/Traditional Chinese names for the supplied watchlist symbols BABA, COST, BIDU, FUTU, SAP, AMD, INTC, NVDA, TSLA, BULL, HOOD, AXP, NFLX, WMT, ORCL, GRAB, IBKR, MSFT, BRK.B, KO, QQQ, SE, GOOG, AAPL, IVV, PDD, ASML, TSM, MU, and SPCX while preserving existing AMZN and META aliases.

SpaceX resolves to SPCX; Google, Alphabet, and 谷歌 resolve to GOOGL per the user's final decision; explicit uppercase GOOG and GOOGL requests retain the exact ticker and take precedence over name aliases.

Company and ETF name aliases require explicit stock intent, preserve bare-name ambiguity behavior such as 苹果怎么样, use safe Latin word boundaries, and do not introduce Singapore-market routing, live lookup, broad conversational guesses, or secret disclosure.

Table-driven router tests cover every watchlist symbol plus representative English and Chinese aliases, SpaceX and GOOG/GOOGL regressions, explicit ticker precedence, and non-stock ambiguity; mocked answer-path or text-debug tests prove the existing Finnhub provider receives the resolved symbol without live network access.

README or manual documentation describes the personal US watchlist name coverage and representative requests, and focused tests, full unittest discovery, and final ./init.sh pass without changing Finnhub quote semantics or requiring live audio, OpenAI, or network.

features.title: Preserve speech overlapping wake acknowledgement
features.description: Buffer a bounded safe tail while wake acknowledgement audio plays, then use post-playback speech evidence and a real noise floor to retain an overlapping question prefix without allowing acknowledgement echo to trigger recording by itself.
acceptance: Observable ACK playback returns a structured drain handoff containing bounded safe playback-tail chunks, useful low-energy noise-seed chunks, overlap quarantine and drain metrics; overflowed chunks are omitted, clipped chunks cannot become evidence, and failure or overflow preserves the conservative quiet-boundary fallback.

Playback-time chunks alone cannot satisfy the ARMED voiced window, but when a question begins during acknowledgement and continues after playback, valid post-playback energy, rolling-voice, latest-chunk, optional-VAD, baseline, and useful-noise-floor evidence can trigger recording with the retained playback tail included as protected pre-roll.

Synchronized ARMED fails closed when useful noise-floor samples are absent and logs noise_floor_has_samples, playback-tail duration/counts, noise-seed counts, quarantined overlap, synchronization, and fallback decisions without raw audio or secrets.

Acknowledgement echo or silence alone cancels locally without recording or OpenAI, while a conservative exact configured acknowledgement-prefix cleanup removes a leading acknowledgement STT artifact only when useful question text remains; acknowledgement-only and existing cancel behavior remain local.

ACK-disabled, guard-disabled, synchronous/fake player, VAD-disabled, optional-VAD, clipped/overflow, post-cancellation, post-answer-playback, and fake-backend flows remain deterministic; documentation clearly states that speech must continue past playback completion because full AEC is out of scope.

Focused state-machine/config/documentation tests, full unittest discovery, dry-run, fake-backend, diagnose, final ./init.sh, and documented real-device retesting cover speech during acknowledgement, at playback completion, and one second afterward without requiring live hardware, OpenAI, speaker, or network in automated tests.

features.title: Route spoken Chinese arithmetic locally
features.description: Parse common Simplified and Traditional Chinese integer arithmetic into the existing safe calculator so voice transcripts such as 一加一等于几 do not fall through to chat.
acceptance: Router parsing converts common Chinese integer operands using 零/〇, 一 through 九, 两/兩, 十, 百, and 千 plus existing 加/减/減/乘/除 operators into safe numeric expressions, while unsupported or ambiguous natural-language math falls through without guessing.
Simplified and Traditional requests including 一加一等于几 and 一加一等於幾 route to calculator/safe_calculator and return The answer is 2 through text debug without OpenAI or network access.
The normal post-transcription answer path uses the local calculator, does not call ask_chatgpt, and does not mutate chat history for the affected spoken requests.
Existing digit-based Chinese, symbolic, English, Traditional operator, calculator safety, wake/ACK/audio, provider, and tool-answer behavior remain unchanged.
Focused router, execution, text-debug, answer-path, documentation tests, full unittest discovery, and final ./init.sh pass without live microphone, OpenAI chat, speaker, or network.

features.title: Curate current Known Issues
features.description: Reduce progress.md Known Issues to unresolved product/runtime defects, separate operational constraints, and remove completed-feature and obsolete workaround history while preserving durable evidence elsewhere.
acceptance: Known Issues contains only currently unresolved defects with concise impact, current safe workaround, and durable evidence references; Recording VAD and WebRTC dependency/diagnostic gaps remain explicit.

Resolved acknowledgement overlap, wake-model, post-playback, empty-transcription, provider, local-routing, fallback, and orchestration history is removed from Known Issues without deleting feature summaries, run evidence, or git history.

Python version support, macOS microphone permission, and the limits of automated live-hardware/OpenAI verification are clearly separated as operational or verification constraints rather than labeled defects.

The resulting recovery state has no stale claim that users must wait after the acknowledgement, does not claim unresolved VAD behavior is fixed, and identifies Recording VAD as disabled by default/current workaround.
Feature JSON validation, focused text inspection, and final ./init.sh recovery verification pass without product-code or runtime configuration changes.

features.title: Make WebRTC VAD installation and diagnostics reliable
features.description: Declare a reproducible optional WebRTC VAD dependency set and make diagnostics exercise the configured detector's real import, construction, and frame-classification path instead of module discovery alone.
acceptance: A project-owned optional requirements file pins webrtcvad 2.0.10 and the verified compatible setuptools range, and setup/troubleshooting documentation uses that file instead of installing webrtcvad alone while ordinary VAD-disabled installs remain unchanged.

When VAD_BACKEND=webrtc, diagnostics use the configured VAD_MODE and the production build_vad_detector boundary, then classify one valid 20ms mono int16 silence frame before reporting dependency:webrtcvad OK.

Module discovery without a working import, missing pkg_resources, detector construction errors, and frame-classification errors all produce dependency:webrtcvad ERROR with safe root-cause context and the reproducible optional-install command; they never produce the former false-positive OK.

VAD_BACKEND=disabled remains the default, does not import or require webrtcvad/pkg_resources, and Recording VAD remains disabled/safely documented without changing ARMED, recorder endpointing, wake, ACK, or OpenAI behavior.
Focused config/VAD/documentation tests, full unittest discovery, default disabled diagnose, and final ./init.sh pass without live microphone, speaker, OpenAI, or network access.

features.title: Answer stable knowledge questions without false internet refusal
features.description: Strengthen the general-chat answer policy so non-realtime knowledge questions receive concise qualified best-effort answers instead of being refused merely because comparison or uncertainty could benefit from browsing.
acceptance: The general-chat system prompt requires best-effort answers for stable non-high-stakes knowledge, concise qualification of broad or disputed premises, and the user's language when clear, while forbidding claims of browsing or verification that did not occur.

The prompt says that comparison, ambiguity, scholarly uncertainty, or potentially useful verification alone are not reasons for an internet-required refusal; genuinely uncertain stable questions still receive useful known context with calibrated uncertainty.

The historical-linguistics example routes to ordinary chat with the strengthened prompt, while current news and other existing freshness-sensitive requests retain deterministic provider/refusal behavior and do not fall through to chat speculation.

Fake-SDK request-shape tests prove the policy is sent before bounded history without live OpenAI, and router/documentation regressions cover stable-versus-realtime examples without changing chat history, structured tools, configured models, or API boundaries.

README and manual testing document the stable-knowledge policy, its no-browsing/no-citation boundary, representative Chinese questions, and optional live evaluation; focused tests, full unittest discovery, dry-run, fake-backend, diagnose, and final ./init.sh pass without live audio, OpenAI, speaker, or network.

features.title: Make Recording VAD stop reliably after normal speech
features.description: Use asymmetric RMS/VAD endpoint hysteresis so false-high WebRTC voice ratios on low-energy post-speech audio cannot keep question recording alive until max duration.
acceptance: With Recording VAD enabled, only chunks that have both speech-level RMS and a VAD ratio at or above RECORDING_VAD_SPEECH_RATIO reset the end-silence window and refresh hangover; VAD alone cannot extend low-energy audio.

After normal speech, sustained RMS at or below RECORDING_SILENCE_RMS advances the tolerant end-silence window even when WebRTC remains falsely at vad_ratio=1.0, and recording stops with stopped_by=silence after configured hangover plus end silence instead of max duration.

Continuous speech-level RMS with matching VAD evidence still records to source exhaustion or MAX_RECORD_SECONDS, high-RMS/VAD-low noise is not treated as quiet, occasional noisy chunks remain tolerated by the existing recent window, and maximum-duration safety is preserved.

VAD-disabled RMS endpointing, existing configuration keys/defaults, recorder/state-machine call shapes, ARMED/pre-roll, wake/ACK, transcription, and routing remain unchanged; RECORDING_VAD_ENABLED stays disabled by default pending real-device acceptance.

Focused synthetic disagreement/hangover/window/config/wiring/documentation tests, full unittest discovery, dry-run, fake backend, and final ./init.sh pass; manual guidance defines a Python 3.12 real trial requiring normal continuous questions to log stopped_by=silence before any future default enablement.

features.title: Parse spoken Chinese multiplication operands completely
features.description: Fix 乘以 normalization and add conservative 万/萬 integer sections so spoken multiplication does not truncate to an incomplete expression such as 100*.
acceptance: The calculator normalizer replaces 乘以 as one operator before handling bare 乘, so 一百乘以一千等于多少 and Traditional variants extract complete expressions rather than leaving 以 and truncating to 100*.

Conservative Chinese integer parsing supports one valid 万/萬 section with under-10000 components, including 一万/一萬 and common values through 99,999,999, while malformed repeated units, ambiguous consecutive digit readings, 亿/億, and unsafe text are rejected without guessing.

Simplified and Traditional requests for 100 times 1000 and 100 times 10000 route to calculator/safe_calculator and return 100000 and 1000000 through execution and text debug without OpenAI or network access.

The normal answer path skips ask_chatgpt and chat-history mutation for the affected requests; existing bare 乘, 加/减/減/除以, thousands, digit/symbolic/English arithmetic, and calculator safety remain unchanged.
Focused parser/router/execution/text-debug/answer-path/documentation tests, full unittest discovery, and final ./init.sh pass without live microphone, speaker, OpenAI, or network.
